items.source: Returns a bound operations object to perform operations on the hash field expiration for all hash fields at the bound BoundKeyOperations.getKey() for the given hash fields.
items.translation: 返回一个绑定操作对象，用于对给定哈希字段在指定 BoundKeyOperations.getKey() 处的所有哈希字段的过期时间执行操作。

items.source: Returns a bound operations object to perform operations on the hash field expiration for all hash fields at key for the given hash fields.
items.translation: 返回一个绑定操作对象，用于对指定哈希字段在 key 处的所有哈希字段的过期时间执行操作。

items.source: Returns a bound operations object to perform operations on the hash field expiration for all hash fields at the bound key for the given hash fields.
items.translation: 返回一个绑定操作对象，用于对给定哈希字段在绑定的key上的所有哈希字段的过期时间执行操作。
